summary: The filing is a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01, disclosing routine daily disclosures to the Australian Securities Exchange regarding an existing stock repurchase program. The program authorizes up to $1 billion in aggregate repurchases of Class A and Class B common stock. No specific terms, prices, or new authorizations are provided; the filing merely updates compliance with ASX rules. This is an ordinary capital allocation disclosure, not a special situation event. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are noted. No risk-arb angle applies.
